name: saas-rich
note: The reference case: a product with real proof points and a clear buyer. Everything should be clean.

brief.productDescription: Matches invoices, bank feeds and payment processor payouts automatically and flags exceptions for review.
brief.targetAudience: Finance leads and controllers at 50-500 person SaaS companies

sources.name: home.md
sources.text: Close the month without the spreadsheet. Ledgerline matches payouts, invoices and bank feeds overnight. We say exceptions, never errors. From EUR 190 a month per connected entity. 14-day trial, no card. SOC 2 Type II. Connects to Stripe, Adyen, GoCardless and 2,400 banks. In our 2026 survey of 210 finance leads, customers reported closing the month four days faster on average.

sources.name: careers.md
sources.text: We write short. We would rather ship a plain sentence than a clever one. No exclamation marks in product copy.
